DRAWING AND DOCUMENT NUMBERS: The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

1604-00-PL-0210 RevA - Combined Site Plan – Location Plan; 

IS-6A-A002-1 A - Unit G6A Plan; 

Fe Fe Fanclub Change of Use Drawings – dated, 23 January 2025 

Planning Design and Access Statement, produced by Monmouth Planning Ltd, dated March 2025

Noise Impact Assessment, produced by SRL, dated 16 December 2025

REASON: To comply with Section 70(1)(a) of the Town and Country Act 1990 as amended and the Reason for Grant and also for the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
description:
Application under Section 73 (minor material amendment) of the Town and Country Planning Act (1990) for the variation of Condition 3 (Class E flexible uses) of planning permission ref: P2022/2874/FUL, dated 27/09/2022, that granted:

Proposed sub-division of existing ground floor retail unit within Block A, into two units, and the change of use of both units to Class E. No external changes.

The proposed variation of Condition 3 seeks to allow the use of Unit 1 (6F Esther Anne Place) as a Class E (f) creche. The creche would offer play areas for children for a maximum of 2 hours in pre-booked sessions while residents/ visitors are shopping or using the local facilities.
status: Called in by Secretary of State
